‘NO TO MINING IN DUPAX DEL NORTE’

LOOK: Environmental defenders stage a protest in front of the DENR central office in Quezon City on Friday, Jan. 23, following a court order directing authorities to arrest protesters who continue to block a mining company from conducting exploration activities in Dupax del Norte, Nueva Vizcaya.

The protest calls on the DENR to immediately revoke Woggle Corp’s exploration permit and halt all mining-related activities in the area. | 📸: Kalikasan via @MJSalcedoINQ
